description: Defines synchronization utilities for IARM event handling, including handler registration, removal, and management of class-specific handlers with thread safety.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::IarmHandlers
classes.description: Template struct managing a static map of IARM event handlers per class type.

methods.name: _generic_iarm_handler
methods.description: Generic handler invoked for IARM events, calls the registered handler for the specific owner and event ID with thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedIarmEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific owner and event ID with thread safety, using a generic handler.

methods.name: RemoveLockedEventHandler
methods.description: Removes a registered event handler for a specific owner and event ID with thread safety, erasing from the handler map.
